order_line_draws_cost_bounds.name: order_line_draws_cost_bounds
order_line_draws_cost_bounds.value: ("order_line_draws"."unit_cost_millipaise_per_base" is null or "order_line_draws"."unit_cost_millipaise_per_base" >= 0) and ("order_line_draws"."cost_paise" is null or "order_line_draws"."cost_paise" >= 0)

order_lines_amount_bounds.name: order_lines_amount_bounds
order_lines_amount_bounds.value: "order_lines"."unit_price_paise" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "order_lines"."line_total_paise" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and ("order_lines"."cost_snapshot_paise" is null or "order_lines"."cost_snapshot_paise" between 0 and 9007199254740991)

order_status_events_status.name: order_status_events_status
order_status_events_status.value: "order_status_events"."to_status" in ('ordered', 'in_kitchen', 'baking', 'out_of_oven', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'completed', 'cancelled') and ("order_status_events"."from_status" is null or "order_status_events"."from_status" in ('ordered', 'in_kitchen', 'baking', 'out_of_oven', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'completed', 'cancelled'))

orders_amount_bounds.name: orders_amount_bounds
orders_amount_bounds.value: "orders"."subtotal_paise" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "orders"."tax_paise" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "orders"."total_paise" between 0 and 9007199254740991

orders_tax_snapshot.name: orders_tax_snapshot
orders_tax_snapshot.value: "orders"."tax_mode" in ('none', 'exclusive', 'inclusive') and "orders"."tax_rate_millipercent" between 0 and 100000 and ("orders"."tax_mode" <> 'none' or "orders"."tax_rate_millipercent" = 0)

recipes_tenant_stock_ingredient_uq.name: recipes_tenant_stock_ingredient_uq
recipes_tenant_stock_ingredient_uq.where: "recipes"."stock_ingredient_id" is not null and "recipes"."deleted_at" is null

stock_movements_cost_on_valued_inflow.name: stock_movements_cost_on_valued_inflow
stock_movements_cost_on_valued_inflow.value: ("stock_movements"."movement_type"::text in ('purchase', 'production')) = ("stock_movements"."unit_cost_millipaise_per_base" is not null and "stock_movements"."total_cost_paise" is not null)

stock_movements_manual_has_reason.name: stock_movements_manual_has_reason
stock_movements_manual_has_reason.value: case when "stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('adjustment', 'wastage') then "stock_movements"."reason" is not null else "stock_movements"."reason" is null end

stock_movements_reason_matches_type.name: stock_movements_reason_matches_type
stock_movements_reason_matches_type.value:
"stock_movements"."reason" is null
          or ("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'adjustment' and "stock_movements"."reason" in ('count_correction', 'theft', 'other'))
          or ("stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'wastage' and "stock_movements"."reason" in ('spoilage', 'expiry', 'burnt', 'dropped', 'trim', 'other'))
